# Complete type and member index

Every registered PPL 4.00 host object, built-in record and enum is listed here. Signatures and descriptions share their sources with the compiler and editor. Start with the [object model](../objects.md) for acquisition, lifetimes, access checks and examples. Square brackets in a parameter list mean optional arguments; brackets following a type describe array rank.
